cat_rows: This category contains information about the blood pool. This usually refers to blood within the left ventricular cavity. This can be identified automatically by CVI, or by the user who draws a region of interest around it. Measuring signal intensity of this is needed for quantitative perfusion. This test was done on the 1946 birth cohort participants who took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
